response.overview: On an ordinary day, a man receives a call that changes everything: he has just three minutes to live. The world around him seems to freeze as the pressure of those three minutes crushes him. Immersed in a rising state of panic and despair, the protagonist begins reflecting on all the wrong choices, the words left unspoken, and the small daily actions he has always taken for granted. Memories overwhelm him—moments that once seemed insignificant now weigh heavily—ignoring a neighbor, not giving way to an elderly person, a love left undeclared.  The ticking clock becomes his only companion as the seconds tick relentlessly towards the fateful 8:00. Overwhelmed by remorse and the feeling of having no escape, the man makes an extreme decision, raising a gun to his head as the clock changes from.
response.title: Three Minutes
